info.name: Look up advertisers and their program details

params.name: requestor-cid
params.description: CID of the company you are making the request for. You must be a member of that company.

params.name: advertiser-ids
params.description: Comma-separated advertiser CIDs, or `joined`, or `notjoined`. An empty string currently behaves the same as `notjoined`.

params.name: advertiser-name
params.description: Advertiser program name, or program URL.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Keywords found in the advertiser's name, product name or product description. Supports `+` and `-`; default logic is OR.

params.name: page-number
params.description: Page of the result set to view.

params.name: records-per-page
params.description: Records per page. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

params.name: mobile-tracking-certified
params.description: Limit to advertisers certified (or not certified) for mobile tracking.

items.docs: Find advertisers in the CJ network by CID, program name or program URL, joined or not joined, with account status, EPC, categories, link types and default Program Term commission rates. Commission rates for Situations and Promotional Properties are NOT included — use the GraphQL Program Terms API for those. Publishers only. Documented call limit: 25 calls per minute.
